Meta.siteTitle: Health by Fatima — Where healthcare meets ideas
Meta.siteDescription: Health by Fatima is a healthcare media platform: conversations with the people shaping healthcare — at the intersection of medicine, management, business, policy and innovation.
Meta.partnershipsDescription: Three ways to work with Health by Fatima: join as an expert guest, media packages for doctors, and brand partnerships.
Meta.beGuestDescription: Doctors, surgeons, healthcare leaders and researchers can apply to be a guest on the Health by Fatima podcast.
Meta.packagesDescription: Podcast and media packages for doctors: a podcast interview, a YouTube episode, Instagram content and Doctor Spotlight.
Meta.brandDescription: Sponsorship and co-created content for brands in healthcare, business, innovation, wellness and education.

Home.title: A 360° view of healthcare.
Home.text: Conversations with the people shaping healthcare — at the intersection of medicine, management, business, policy and innovation.
Home.bentoTitle: Media, expertise and partnerships — on one platform
Home.orbitText: Every episode is published in full on YouTube, then cut into short formats for Instagram.
Home.topicsText: From clinical practice to health policy — conversations across six areas.
Home.guestsCardTitle: Our guests are not only doctors
Home.guestsCardText: Surgeons, healthcare leaders, researchers, finance and management professionals, technology and innovation experts.
Home.treeText: One studio recording becomes content on four platforms.
Home.shieldText: Every episode is prepared with specialists; the content is educational in nature.
Home.collabTitle: How to work with Health by Fatima
Home.pathGuestText: Are you a doctor, surgeon, healthcare leader or researcher? Share your knowledge and experience with our audience.
Home.pathPackagesText: For doctors: professional visibility through a podcast interview, a YouTube episode and Instagram content.
Home.pathBrandText: Sponsorship, brand integration and co-created content projects.
Home.founderBio: Founder and host of Health by Fatima. Her interests include public health, health systems and policy, digital health and innovation. Through the project she brings together professionals from many fields who are shaping the future of healthcare on one platform.
Home.ctaText: Becoming a guest, a media package or a brand partnership — send your request and our team will get in touch.

Partnerships.title: Three ways to work with Health by Fatima
Partnerships.text: Join as an expert guest, choose a media package as a doctor, or become a strategic partner with your brand. Each path has its own page and its own application form.
Partnerships.guestText: Doctors, surgeons, healthcare leaders, researchers and other professionals share their knowledge and experience with our audience.
Partnerships.guestPoint1: Studio recording of about one hour
Partnerships.packagesText: A podcast interview, a YouTube episode, an Instagram collab, Reels and an individual doctor profile — a paid collaboration format.
Partnerships.brandText: Sponsorship and co-created content for companies in healthcare, business, innovation, wellness and education.
Partnerships.principleText: An invited expert and a doctor who pays for promotion are different formats, so they are presented on separate pages. Paid and sponsored content is always labelled.

BeGuest.lead: Health by Fatima invites professionals from every area of healthcare to share their knowledge, clinical experience and professional perspective with our audience.
BeGuest.whoText: Doctors, surgeons, healthcare leaders, researchers and other professionals can apply to be a guest on the project.
BeGuest.hourText: The studio recording lasts about an hour.
BeGuest.questionsText: The interview follows 10 questions agreed with the guest beforehand. The questions are shared before the recording, and the guest can suggest changes.
BeGuest.youtubeText: The full episode is published on the YouTube channel.
BeGuest.shortsText: Short video clips for Instagram are cut from the episode.
BeGuest.studioText: The recording takes place in a professional podcast studio; the address is sent in advance.
BeGuest.applyText: Fill in the application form. Our team will contact you about the recording format, the topic and a suitable date.

Packages.title: Podcast and media collaboration packages
Packages.lead: A podcast interview with Dr. Fatima Nuriyeva, a YouTube episode and content on the @healthbyfatima Instagram account — for a doctor’s professional presentation.
Packages.notice: Content produced under a paid collaboration is labelled accordingly.
Packages.bonusTitle: 1 month of free subscription in the Həkim Burada app
Packages.bonusText: In Həkim Burada, an app for finding and presenting doctors, you are listed according to the app’s features with:
Packages.bonusNote: A joint offer with Həkim Burada, a partner of Health by Fatima.
Packages.applyText: Choose a package and send your details. The recording date, topic and questions are agreed together with you.

Brand.title: Strategic partnerships for brands and sponsors
Brand.lead: Health by Fatima is open to strategic partnerships with companies and brands working in healthcare, business, innovation, wellness and education. We prepare suitable partnership formats, sponsorship opportunities and co-created content projects for brands.
Brand.offerText: Send us a short note about your brand and goals. We will present a suitable partnership format and terms separately.
Brand.offerNote: Sponsored content is always marked with a “Sponsored” label.
